description: Header file for loading basic TrueType font tables in the FreeType project, defining functions for accessing and loading font tables such as head, cmap, maxp, name, os2, post, pclt, gasp, and optionally bhed.

methods.name: tt_face_lookup_table
methods.description: Looks up a font table by tag in a TrueType font face.

methods.name: tt_face_goto_table
methods.description: Navigates to a specific font table in the font stream.

methods.name: tt_face_load_font_dir
methods.description: Loads the font directory from the font stream.

methods.name: tt_face_load_any
methods.description: Loads any font table given its tag and offset.

methods.name: tt_face_load_head
methods.description: Loads the 'head' table of the font.

methods.name: tt_face_load_os2
methods.description: Loads the OS/2 and Windows metrics table.

methods.name: tt_face_free_name
methods.description: Frees resources associated with the name table.

methods.name: tt_face_load_bhed
methods.description: Loads the embedded bitmap header table, if option enabled.
